theme: retro terminal meets modern IDE (dark navy/charcoal default with light-mode toggle)

typography.accents: JetBrains Mono with neon green (#00FF66) and cyan (#00E5FF) highlights

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
accessibility.data_testid: Included on all interactive and key informational elements

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use universal transitions (transition: all)
Every interactive element must have hover and focus states
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes
Ensure high contrast in both dark and light modes
